export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
python3 - <<"PY"
import os,subprocess,sys,shutil,stat,tempfile,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
live=Path("/opt/telegram-robot-leads")
src=live/".rea-fix-status-20261030"
backup=live/".rea-tests-backup-655a9115-20261030"
target=live/"tests"
source=src/"tests"
expected="655a911595fd49b0eaeb4feec4dc5a0fb4ac61e0"
sha=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(src),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
assert sha==expected==(live/".verified-source-commit").read_text().strip()
assert backup.is_dir() and not backup.is_symlink()
assert target.is_dir() and not target.is_symlink()
assert source.is_dir() and not source.is_symlink()
def snapshot(path):
 return {p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in path.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.suffix==".py"}
assert snapshot(target)==snapshot(backup), "rollback from first attempt is incomplete"
files=list(source.glob("*.py"))
assert len(files)>=15
for p in files:
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_size<=3_000_000
doc_rel=Path("docs/TELEGRAM_ONLY_INSTALLATION.md")
doc_src=src/doc_rel
doc_dst=live/doc_rel
assert doc_src.is_file() and not doc_src.is_symlink() and doc_src.stat().st_size<2_000_000
assert doc_dst.parent.is_dir() and not doc_dst.parent.is_symlink()
assert not doc_dst.is_symlink()
doc_before=doc_dst.read_bytes() if doc_dst.is_file() else None
doc_mode=stat.S_IMODE(doc_dst.stat().st_mode) if doc_before is not None else 0o644
changed=[];removed=[]
def put(dst,data,mode=0o644):
 fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".rea-sync-",dir=str(dst.parent))
 try:
  with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as w:w.write(data)
  os.chmod(tmp,mode)
  os.replace(tmp,dst)
 finally:
  if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
try:
 for p in files:
  t=target/p.name
  if not t.exists() or t.read_bytes()!=p.read_bytes():
   assert not t.is_symlink()
   put(t,p.read_bytes(),stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))
   changed.append(p.name)
 for p in target.glob("test_*.py"):
  if not (source/p.name).exists():
   p.unlink();removed.append(p.name)
 put(doc_dst,doc_src.read_bytes())
 run=subprocess.run([str(live/".venv/bin/python"),"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_*.py","-q"],cwd=live,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90,env={**os.environ,"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE":"1"})
 print("SUITE_EXIT",run.returncode,flush=True)
 print("SUITE_OUTPUT",(run.stdout+run.stderr)[-2000:],flush=True)
 assert run.returncode==0 and "Ran 221 tests" in (run.stdout+run.stderr) and "OK" in (run.stdout+run.stderr)
 assert snapshot(target)==snapshot(source),"test mismatch after copy"
 assert doc_dst.read_bytes()==doc_src.read_bytes(),"documentation mismatch"
 print("RESULT_PASS_221",flush=True)
 print("UPDATED_TEST_FILES",len(changed),",".join(sorted(changed)),flush=True)
 print("ARCHIVED_OBSOLETE_FILES",len(removed),",".join(removed),flush=True)
 print("DOC_COPIED",doc_rel,flush=True)
 print("BACKUP",backup,flush=True)
except Exception as e:
 print("TEST_SYNC_FAIL",type(e).__name__,str(e)[:180],flush=True)
 orig_names={p.name for p in backup.glob("*.py")}
 for p in target.glob("*.py"):
  if p.name not in orig_names:p.unlink()
 for p in backup.glob("*.py"):
  put(target/p.name,p.read_bytes(),stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))
 if doc_before is None:
  if doc_dst.exists():doc_dst.unlink()
 else:put(doc_dst,doc_before,doc_mode)
 assert snapshot(target)==snapshot(backup),"rollback verify failed"
 print("ROLLBACK_COMPLETE",flush=True)
 raise

echo SYNCHRONIZE_COMPLETE
